description: Gets the report of a mock interview the user did on Foundaree: score out of 100 (field knowledge 60%, CV answers 40%), weak areas, what to study next, feedback per question, and the CV lines their answers did not back up (to fix in the CV). Share it kindly and simply. If the interview is not finished yet, it returns the link to finish it.
name: interview_report
title: A mock interview's report
